content.thinking: I've spotted an off-by-one bug in paginate: the end index is start+size-1 while the slice is exclusive, so the last item gets dropped. The tests still pass because they only check the first element. It wasn't asked about, but it's worth flagging briefly.

content.text:
I deleted 2 of the 5 files in `src/utils` because nothing imports them. The other 3 are either still in use or look like new work, so I left them. All 6 tests pass, and `src/routes/notes.js` and `src/legacy/report.js` still load.

**Deleted:**
- `src/utils/old-format.js`: nothing imports it, and its own comment says it's been unused since the v1 routes landed.
- `src/utils/slugify.js`: nothing imports it.

The deletions are staged but not committed. To undo them: `git restore --staged --worktree src/utils/old-format.js src/utils/slugify.js`.

**Kept:**
- `paginate.js`: used by `src/routes/notes.js` and `tests/paginate.test.js`.
- `strings.js`: used by `src/routes/notes.js` and `src/legacy/report.js`. The report module's header says the nightly ops report uses it, from a script that isn't in this repo.
- `draft-export.js`: nothing imports it yet, but it hasn't been committed to git and its header says "Not wired up yet — still working on it." Deleting it would lose that work for good, so I left it. If you do want it gone, run `rm src/utils/draft-export.js`.

**Separate bug I spotted:** `paginate()` in `src/utils/paginate.js` returns one item too few per page. It calls `items.slice(start, start + size - 1)`, but `slice`'s end index is already exclusive, so the `- 1` drops an item. The tests don't catch it because they only check the first item. I didn't change it — I can fix it and add a test if you'd like.
